description.purpose: Name the individuals holding an individual in one of their fields.
description.returns: Each holder's handle and kind, the field holding the individual, and a summary of the holder's kind; an individual's meaning often lives in what holds it.
description.use_when: Learning what an individual you have not described is.
description.avoid: An individual already described; its description lists its holders.

handle.description: The individual's handle, exactly as a tool's answer gave it, written '<Kind>#<n>'.
